name: Pre-dawn
text: before dawn, deep indigo sky, faint glow on the horizon, last stars fading, cold still air

name: Dawn
text: at dawn, soft pale light, {pink|lavender|peach} glow along the horizon, thin morning mist, quiet stillness

name: Sunrise
text: at sunrise, pink and orange sky, fresh morning light

name: Morning
text: in the morning, clear fresh light, low sun casting long soft shadows, {dew on the grass|bright blue sky}

name: Midday
text: at midday, sun high overhead, harsh bright light, short hard shadows, vivid colors

name: Afternoon
text: in the afternoon, warm even sunlight, sun slowly lowering, lengthening shadows, hazy blue sky

name: Golden hour
text: at golden hour, low warm sun, honey-colored light, long glowing shadows, soft rim light

name: Sunset
text: at sunset, fiery orange sky, long shadows

name: Blue hour
text: during the blue hour, deep cobalt twilight sky, glowing windows and street lights, cool soft shadowless light

name: Dusk
text: at dusk, last light fading on the horizon, dim {purple|rose and gray} sky, darkening silhouettes, first stars appearing

name: Night
text: at night, {moonlit|under a starry sky|lit by city lights}, deep blue darkness

name: Midnight
text: at midnight, pitch-dark sky, {a full moon high above|a sky full of stars|a single glowing streetlight}, inky shadows, deep silence
